name: Grist, the Hunger Tide
oracle_text:
As long as Grist isn't on the battlefield, it's a 1/1 Insect creature in addition to its other types.
+1: Create a 1/1 black and green Insect creature token, then mill a card. If an Insect card was milled this way, put a loyalty counter on Grist and repeat this process.
−2: You may sacrifice a creature. When you do, destroy target creature or planeswalker.
−5: Each opponent loses life equal to the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
blocked_sentences: As long as Grist isn't on the battlefield, it's a 1/1 Insect creature in addition to its other types.
+1: Create a 1/1 black and green Insect creature token, then mill a card. If an Insect card was milled this way, put a loyalty counter on Grist and repeat this process.

needs.what: a 1/1 black and green Insect creature token (e.g. insect_1_1_bg)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has insect_1_1_g (green only), insect_1_1_b_flying (black, flying) and the black-green pest_1_1_bg / worm_1_1_bg, but no black-green Insect with no abilities; a near token would be the wrong colour or creature type

needs.what: a loop op that repeats a block of effects while a condition read after each iteration holds: create token, mill one card bound as 'milled', and if the milled card has subtype Insect, add a loyalty counter to self and run the block again; stops when a non-Insect is milled or the library is empty
needs.why_existing_wont_do: repeat takes only a fixed amount and effects, and if runs its branch once; nothing re-enters the block conditionally on the outcome of the previous pass

needs.what: a characteristic-defining static that works in every zone except the battlefield (hand, library, graveyard, exile, stack, command) and adds the Creature type, Insect subtype and base 1/1, so the card is a creature card in the graveyard and a creature spell when cast from the command zone
needs.why_existing_wont_do: set_types / set_creature_types / set_pt are battlefield statics over permanents; active_zones lets a static be gathered from other zones, but there is no evidence that type or P/T changes from it are applied to the card's own characteristics in hand, graveyard, library, stack or command zone, nor any way to say 'every zone but the battlefield'
